questions.question: Ba nhom quyen cua mot file la gi, theo thu tu?
questions.answer: user (owner), group, other. Moi nhom co ba bit rwx.

questions.question: Gia tri octal cua r (read) la bao nhieu?
Gia tri octal cua w (write) la bao nhieu?
Gia tri octal cua x (execute) la bao nhieu?
Ky tu dau tien cua chuoi ls -l cho biet gi? Cho vai vi du.
questions.answer: Cho biet loai doi tuong: '-' file thuong, 'd' directory, 'l' symlink (con c, b, s, p cho device/socket/pipe).

questions.question: chmod dung de lam gi?
questions.answer: chmod doi quyen (rwx) cua file/thu muc — ai duoc lam gi.

questions.question: chown dung de lam gi?
questions.answer: chown doi chu so huu (owner/group) cua file — ai la user/group so huu.

questions.question: Dau gach '-' o vi tri mot bit quyen nghia la gi?
questions.answer: Bit do dang tat (khong co quyen tuong ung).

questions.question: Chuoi 10 ky tu dau dong ls -l tach thanh nhung phan nao?
questions.answer: 1 ky tu loai, roi ba nhom ba bit: user, group, other. Vi du -rwxr-xr-x.

questions.question: chmod +x tren mot file lam gi?
questions.answer: Bat execute bit — danh dau file la chay duoc (thuc thi nhu chuong trinh).

questions.question: Doi octal 644 sang chuoi symbolic.
questions.answer: 644 = rw-r--r-- : owner doc+ghi, group va other chi doc.

questions.question: Doi octal 755 sang chuoi symbolic.
questions.answer: 755 = rwxr-xr-x : owner lam tat, group va other doc+chay.

questions.question: Doi octal 600 sang chuoi symbolic va cho biet dung cho gi.
questions.answer: 600 = rw------- : chi owner doc+ghi. Dung cho secret, SSH key, .env.

questions.question: Doi octal 700 sang chuoi symbolic.
questions.answer: 700 = rwx------ : chi owner, toan quyen. Dung cho thu muc/script rieng tu.

questions.question: Chu so octal 7 ung voi chuoi bit nao?
Chu so octal 5 ung voi chuoi bit nao?
Cu phap symbolic cua chmod gom nhung phan nao?
questions.answer: [ugoa][+-=][rwx]: u=user, g=group, o=other, a=all; + them, - bot, = dat dung bang; roi rwx.

questions.question: Khac biet co ban giua chmod octal va chmod symbolic la gi?
questions.answer: Octal dat trang thai tuyet doi (dat ca ba nhom cung luc). Symbolic sua tuong doi (them/bot so voi hien tai).

questions.question: chmod u+x file lam gi?
questions.answer: Them execute bit chi cho user (owner), khong dong toi group hay other.

questions.question: chmod go-r file lam gi?
questions.answer: Bo bit read cua group va other, giu nguyen quyen cua user.

questions.question: chmod a+r file lam gi?
questions.answer: a=all — them read cho ca user, group va other.

questions.question: Voi mot thu muc, r va x nghia la gi?
questions.answer: Voi thu muc: r = liet ke duoc ten file ben trong, x = di vao / truy cap duoc duong dan ben trong. Can ca hai de dung binh thuong.

questions.question: Chay ./script.sh bao permission denied. Loi nam o dau va sua the nao?
questions.answer: Thieu execute bit tren script. Sua bang chmod +x script.sh (hoac u+x neu chi owner can chay).

questions.question: cat vault/secret.txt bao Permission denied du file co r. Nguyen nhan?
questions.answer: Thu muc vault thieu execute bit nen khong truy cap duoc file ben trong. Tra lai x (vi du chmod 755 vault).

questions.question: Nen dung octal hay symbolic trong script, va vi sao?
questions.answer: Dung octal vi no dat trang thai tuyet doi, ket qua khong phu thuoc quyen cu — khong mo ho.

questions.question: umask lam gi voi file moi tao?
questions.answer: umask la mat na tat bot bit. File moi xuat phat tu 666, thu muc tu 777, roi bi umask tat bot cac bit tuong ung.

questions.question: Doc nhanh -rwxr-xr-x thanh octal.
Doi 644 nguoc lai ra chuoi bit bang cach tach tung chu so.
chmod +x khac chmod u+x cho mot script the nao?
questions.answer: +x (khong neu nhom) bat execute cho ca user, group va other — thuong thua. u+x chi cho rieng owner.

questions.question: Doi owner ve chinh minh co can root khong? Doi sang user khac thi sao?
questions.answer: Doi ve chinh minh khong can root. Doi sang user khac can root (sudo).

questions.question: File dang -rw-rw-r--, chay chmod u+x thi ls -l ra chuoi gi?
questions.answer: -rwxrw-r-- : them x cho user, giu nguyen group va other.

questions.question: File dang -rwxr--r--, chay chmod go-r thi ra chuoi gi?
questions.answer: -rwx------ : bo r cua group va other, chi con quyen cua user (rwx).

questions.question: File dang -rwx------, chay chmod a+r thi ra chuoi gi?
questions.answer: -rwxr--r-- : them r cho moi nhom; user van rwx, group va other duoc them r.

questions.question: umask 002, tao file moi bang touch thi file duoc quyen gi?
umask 022, tao file moi bang touch thi file duoc quyen gi?
umask 022, tao thu muc moi bang mkdir thi thu muc duoc quyen gi?
questions.answer: 755 (drwxr-xr-x). Vi thu muc xuat phat tu 777, 777 - 022 = 755.

questions.question: Chay ./hello.sh bao permission denied va exit code 126. Nghia la gi?
questions.answer: 126 = tim thay lenh nhung khong co quyen chay (thieu execute bit). Sua bang chmod +x roi chay lai.

questions.question: Exit 126 khac exit 127 cho nao?
questions.answer: 126 = tim thay lenh nhung khong co quyen chay (thieu x, dung chmod +x). 127 = khong tim thay lenh (sai duong dan / chua cai) — dung di chmod.

questions.question: Vi sao chmod 777 gan nhu luon la dau hieu lam sai?
questions.answer: 777 = rwxrwxrwx = ai cung doc/ghi/chay duoc, khong con bao ve nao — bat ky user/process nao cung sua duoc file. Thuong chi can +x cho mot file hoac x cho mot thu muc, khong phai mo toang cho ca the gioi.

questions.question: Vi sao file moi khong bao gio co execute bit du umask long?
questions.answer: Diem xuat phat khi tao file la 666 chu khong phai 777 — he thong co tinh khong cap x cho file moi, bat ke umask. Vi vay luon phai chmod +x thu cong cho script moi.

questions.question: Bo x cua thu muc (chmod 644 vault) nhung file ben trong van r. cat file ben trong ra sao?
questions.answer: Bao Permission denied. Khong co x tren thu muc thi khong truy cap duoc file ben trong du ban than file cho doc.

questions.question: ls -ld hien drw-r--r-- cho mot thu muc. Van de gi va thu muc dung duoc khong?
questions.answer: Thu muc thieu x (chi co rw-r--r--). Liet ke duoc ten nhung khong mo duoc file nao ben trong, khong cd vao duoc. Thu muc dung duoc can ca r lan x.

questions.question: Vi sao 666 - 022 ra 644 chu khong phai 666 giu nguyen w cua group/other?
questions.answer: umask 022 tat bit write (2) cua group va other. Nen 666 (rw-rw-rw-) mat hai bit w -> 644 (rw-r--r--). Do la hang rao mac dinh de khong tao file ai cung ghi duoc.

questions.question: Muon script rieng chi owner chay duoc, dung lenh chmod nao? Vi sao khong dung +x?
questions.answer: Dung chmod u+x. chmod +x bat execute cho ca group va other — thua voi script rieng.

questions.question: chmod -R 644 thumuc/ tren cay thu muc gay ra van de gi?
questions.answer: No bo x cua ca cac thu muc con -> khong di vao duoc nua. Voi cay hon hop nen tach: find thumuc -type f -exec chmod 644 {} + va find thumuc -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +.

questions.question: Cach dung find de dat 644 cho file va 755 cho thu muc trong mot cay?
questions.answer: find thumuc -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +  va  find thumuc -type d -exec chmod 755 {} + — tach file va thu muc de khong bo nham x cua thu muc.

questions.question: Khong ghi duoc mot file du minh nghi co quyen w. Nen kiem tra gi truoc khi chmod?
questions.answer: Kiem tra cot owner/group trong ls -l — co the file thuoc user khac, van de la owner chu khong phai bit w. Doc ky truoc khi chmod.

questions.question: Doc chuoi -rwxr-xr-x: loai gi, ai doc/ghi/chay duoc?
questions.answer: File thuong. Owner: doc+ghi+chay (rwx). Group: doc+chay (r-x). Other: doc+chay (r-x).

questions.question: Doc chuoi drwxr-xr-x: loai gi va nghia?
questions.answer: Thu muc (d). Owner co r+w+x (liet ke, tao/xoa, di vao). Group va other co r+x (liet ke va di vao, khong ghi).

questions.question: chmod 700 vault xong, mot user khac co cd vao vault duoc khong?
questions.answer: Khong. 700 = rwx------ nen group va other khong co x, khong di vao duoc; chi owner truy cap.

questions.question: So thu tu trong chmod nhu 4755, 2755, 1777 la gi?
questions.answer: Chu so dung truoc ba so quyen la special bits: 4=setuid, 2=setgid, 1=sticky bit.

questions.question: 1777 tren /tmp nghia la gi?
questions.answer: Sticky bit (1) cong 777: ai cung ghi duoc nhung chi owner cua tung file moi xoa duoc file do.

questions.question: setuid/setgid lam gi va vi sao can can trong?
questions.answer: Lam chuong trinh chay voi quyen cua owner/group cua file. La be mat tan cong, chi dung khi that hieu.

questions.question: File dang -rw-rw-r-- (664). Chay chmod 600 xong ra chuoi va octal gi?
questions.answer: -rw------- (600): chi owner doc+ghi, group va other khong con quyen nao.

questions.question: File dang -rw-r--r-- (644). Chay chmod 755 xong ra chuoi gi?
questions.answer: -rwxr-xr-x (755): them x cho ca ba nhom, group/other them x thanh r-x.

questions.question: Vi sao chmod 644 nhanh va khong mo ho hon khi muon dat trang thai tuyet doi?
questions.answer: Mot lenh octal dat ca ba nhom cung luc; ket qua khong phu thuoc quyen cu, nen chac chan ve trang thai cuoi cung.

questions.question: umask 002 vs 022 khac nhau the nao ve an toan va lam viec nhom?
questions.answer: 022 an toan hon (chi owner ghi duoc, group khong ghi file ban tao). 002 cho group ghi (tien team) nhung long hon. Chon theo boi canh.

questions.question: chmod u+x data.csv tren -rw-r--r-- cho ra gi, va giai thich vi sao chi user co x?
questions.answer: -rwxr--r-- : symbolic u+x chi them x cho user, khong dong toi group/other nen chung giu r-- va r--.

questions.question: Cap r cho thu muc ma quen x. Hau qua cu the la gi?
questions.answer: Liet ke duoc ten file nhung khong mo duoc file nao ben trong. Thu muc dung duoc can ca r lan x.

questions.question: chown "$(whoami)":"$(id -gn)" owned.txt tren -rw-rw-r-- cua chinh minh cho ket qua gi va can root khong?
questions.answer: Owner/group giu nguyen hoanggggf, quyen -rw-rw-r-- khong doi. Doi ve chinh minh khong can root nen chay duoc that.
